summary: The physics references (Jacquet–Blondel, Bentvelsen et al., Bassler–Bernardi, Kwiatkowski et al./Blümlein) are credited in the code itself, declaration by declaration. But the lemma moved out of Joseph Tooby-Smith's Tensors/Basic.lean lands in a new file credited solely to another author, and the substantial new material added to AccessMethods.lean leaves that file's sole author line unchanged.
